base_url.description: Base URL for the Autoglue API (default: https://autoglue.glueopshosted.com/api/v1).

org_id.description: Organization UUID used for X-Org-ID header. Required when using api_key or bearer_token.

org_key.description: Org key (X-ORG-KEY). Use together with org_secret for org-scoped auth.

org_secret.description: Org secret (X-ORG-SECRET). Use together with org_key for org-scoped auth.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue annotation.

apps_load_balancer_id.description: ID of the apps load balancer attached to this cluster, if any.

bastion_server_id.description: ID of the bastion server attached to this cluster, if any.

captain_domain_id.description: ID of the captain domain attached to this cluster, if any.

certificate_key.description: Cluster certificate key generated by the control plane.

cluster_provider.description: Cluster provider identifier (e.g. aws, azure, gcp).

control_plane_fqdn.description: Effective control-plane FQDN if both domain and record set are attached.

control_plane_record_set_id.description: ID of the control plane record set attached to this cluster, if any.

glueops_load_balancer_id.description: ID of the GlueOps/control-plane load balancer attached to this cluster, if any.

random_token.description: Random token generated by the control plane for this cluster.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue cluster (name, provider, region). Attachments such as domains, record sets, load balancers, bastion and node pools are managed via separate resources.

load_balancer_id.description: Load balancer ID to attach as apps LB.

block.description: Attaches an apps load balancer to a cluster.

server_id.description: Server ID to attach as bastion.

block.description: Attaches a bastion server to a cluster.

domain_id.description: Domain ID to attach as captain domain.

block.description: Attaches a captain domain to a cluster.

record_set_id.description: Record set ID to attach as control-plane record set.

block.description: Attaches a control-plane record set to a cluster.

load_balancer_id.description: Load balancer ID to attach as GlueOps/control-plane LB.

block.description: Attaches a GlueOps/control-plane load balancer to a cluster.

kubeconfig.description: Kubeconfig YAML for the cluster. This value is never read back from the API; it only drives writes.

block.description: Manages a cluster's kubeconfig (write-only). The kubeconfig is encrypted server-side and never returned by the API.

cluster_id.description: Cluster ID this metadata is attached to.

block.description: Manages a cluster metadata key-value pair. Keys are automatically lowercased; values preserve case sensitivity.

node_pool_ids.description: Set of node pool IDs to attach to the cluster.

block.description: Manages the set of node pools attached to a cluster.

account_id.description: Optional cloud account ID associated with this credential.

credential_provider.description: Provider for this credential (for example: aws, gcp, azure).

region.description: Optional cloud region associated with this credential.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this credential's secret format.

scope.description: Arbitrary scope metadata (key/value tags) associated with this credential.

scope_kind.description: Logical scope kind for this credential (for example: "cloud").

scope_version.description: Version of the scope metadata schema.

secret.description: Credential secret payload as a map of key/value pairs. WARNING: values are stored in Terraform state.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue credential (for example, a cloud account credential).

credential_id.description: Credential ID (UUID) bound to this domain. Must be an AWS Route 53 service-scoped credential.

domain_name.description: DNS domain name (FQDN, lowercase, without trailing dot). Changing this requires creating a new domain.

last_error.description: Last provisioning error message, if any.

zone_id.description: Optional zone ID for the backing Route 53 hosted zone. If omitted, the control plane may backfill this automatically.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue DNS domain (backed by AWS Route 53 credentials).
Manages an Autoglue label.

kind.description: Load balancer kind. One of `glueops` or `public`.

private_ip_address.description: Private IPv4 address advertised by this load balancer.

public_ip_address.description: Public IPv4 address advertised by this load balancer.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue load balancer (logical endpoint, identified by kind and IPs).

role.description: Node pool role. Must match the Autoglue API’s enum: "master" or "worker".

block.description: Manages an Autoglue node pool.

annotation_ids.description: Set of annotation IDs to attach to the node pool.

id.description: Synthetic ID for this attachment set (node_pool_id).

block.description: Manages the set of annotations attached to a node pool.

id.description: Synthetic ID for this attachment set (node_pool_id).

label_ids.description: Set of label IDs to attach to the node pool.

block.description: Manages the set of labels attached to a node pool.

id.description: Synthetic ID for this attachment set (node_pool_id).

server_ids.description: Set of server IDs to attach to the node pool.

block.description: Manages the set of servers attached to a node pool.

id.description: Synthetic ID for this attachment set (node_pool_id).

taint_ids.description: Set of taint IDs to attach to the node pool.

block.description: Manages the set of taints attached to a node pool.

domain_id.description: Domain ID this record set belongs to. Changing this requires creating a new record set.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint for the desired record content.

name.description: Record name. May be relative to the domain (e.g. `api`) or FQDN (e.g. `api.example.com`).

ttl.description: TTL in seconds (1–86400). Optional; if omitted, the upstream default may apply.

type.description: DNS record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, NS, SRV, CAA). Validation is enforced by the API.

values.description: Record values (e.g. IP addresses, hostnames, TXT values).

block.description: Manages a DNS record set for an Autoglue domain.

private_ip_address.description: Private IP address of the server.

public_ip_address.description: Public IP address of the server.

role.description: Logical role for the server. Typically one of `master`, `worker`, or `bastion`.

ssh_key_id.description: SSH key ID associated with this server.

ssh_user.description: SSH username used to access this server.

status.description: Server status as reported by Autoglue. One of `pending`, `provisioning`, `ready`, or `failed`.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue server.

bits.description: Key size in bits (RSA only; typically 2048, 3072, or 4096). Ignored for ED25519.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue SSH keypair (public metadata only).

effect.description: Taint effect, for example `NoSchedule`, `PreferNoSchedule`, or `NoExecute`. See Autoglue / Kubernetes taint documentation for valid options.

key.description: Taint key. Changing this forces a new taint to be created.

block.description: Manages an Autoglue taint.

annotations.description: All annotations visible to the organization.

block.description: Lists all annotations in the organization.

apps_load_balancer_id.description: Attached apps load balancer ID, if any.

bastion_server_id.description: Attached bastion server ID, if any.

captain_domain_id.description: Attached captain domain ID, if any.

control_plane_record_set_id.description: Attached control plane record set ID, if any.

glueops_load_balancer_id.description: Attached GlueOps load balancer ID, if any.

search.description: Optional substring filter over cluster name (maps to `q`).

block.description: Lists clusters for the current organization.

scope.description: Scope metadata associated with the credential.

block.description: Reads an Autoglue credential by ID.

domain_name.description: Optional exact domain name filter (lowercase, no trailing dot).

credential_id.description: Credential ID bound to this domain.

zone_id.description: Route 53 zone ID backing this domain.

search.description: Optional substring match filter applied to domain name (maps to the `q` query parameter).

status.description: Optional status filter (pending, provisioning, ready, failed).

block.description: Lists Autoglue DNS domains for the current organization.

labels.description: All labels visible to the organization.

block.description: Lists all labels in the organization.

search.description: Optional substring match filter applied to load balancer name (maps to the `q` query parameter).

block.description: Lists Autoglue load balancers for the current organization.

id.description: Node pool ID to look up.

block.description: Reads an Autoglue node pool by ID.

domain_id.description: Domain ID (UUID) whose records to list.

name.description: Optional name filter. May be relative or FQDN; the server normalizes to a relative name.

status.description: Optional status filter (pending, provisioning, ready, failed).

type.description: Optional RR type filter (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, NS, SRV, CAA). Validation is handled by the API.

block.description: Lists DNS record sets for an Autoglue domain.

ssh_key_id.description: SSH key ID associated with this server.

status.description: Server status as reported by Autoglue.

servers.description: All servers visible to the organization.

block.description: Lists all servers visible to the organization.

content.description: File content returned by the server (format depends on API; often a ZIP or PEM).

part.description: Optional part selector if supported by the API (for example: `all`, `public`, or `private`). If omitted, the server default is used.

block.description: Downloads SSH key files by ID. WARNING: this can place private key material into Terraform state.

keys.description: All SSH keys visible to the organization.

block.description: Lists all SSH keys for the organization.

key.description: Exact taint key to filter by.

taints.description: All taints returned by the API.

value.description: Exact taint value to filter by.

block.description: Lists taints, optionally filtered by key, value, or query string.
